title: Diverse Inference for Solving ARC at a Human Level

contributions.purpose: 用多样化推理提升 ARC 求解率
contributions.mechanism: 测试时聚合多模型/方法/智能体,对可验证任务用合成代码在训练样例上单元测试自动校验
contributions.source_quote: Our approach increases the success rate on a validation set of 400 ARC puzzles from 53% to 69.5% without reasoning models and 91.5% to 93.75% with them which exceeds average human accuracy which is between 73.3 and 77.2%.

contributions.purpose: 测试时生成额外问题信息
contributions.mechanism: 测试时仿真+强化学习微调,合成代码剪枝错误解并精炼候选,用训练验证器搜索
contributions.evaluation: 解出 SOTA 模型未解的 26.5%、948 人集体未解的 80%
contributions.source_quote: We run simulations and reinforcement learning at test time to synthesize additional data that allows us to solve difficult ARC puzzles.

contributions.purpose: 自动化并可扩展 MARC 流程
contributions.mechanism: 用计算图的 agentic 框架自动执行/比较 ARC 求解流水线
contributions.evaluation: 模块化、可扩展、自主执行(定性)
contributions.source_quote: We automate the MARC method by an agentic framework using a computation graph, enabling modular, scalable, and autonomous execution and comparison of ARC problem-solving pipelines.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We automate the MARC method by an agentic framework using a computation graph, enabling modular, scalable, and autonomous execution and comparison of ARC problem-solving pipelines.

notes: 扩展/自动化既有 MARC 方法。结果强但需谨慎:在公开 400 验证集(非私有测试集)、near-perfect 验证器仍承认假阳性设上限;有推理模型时增益仅 +2.25(91.5→93.75);"超人类"框架化表述。无误差棒/单次报告。作者列"AI assistants"及多机构人类合著。accept。
